title: Dhyana
one_line: The fifth of the six limbs named in the Shandilya Upanishad; Guruji does not treat it separately in this chapter beyond naming it.
points: Dhyana is named as the fifth of the six limbs of yoga in the Shandilya Upanishad verse Guruji quotes.

sutra.sanskrit: Asanam pranasamrodhah pratyaharascha dharanam / Dhyanam samadhiretani shadangani prakirtita.
sutra.translation: Asana, pranayama, pratyahara, dharana, dhyana, and samadhi are known as the six limbs.
